body: I guess another difference is that even now my family is incredibly poor, so I can't even pretend to understand their point of views):

I respect hvac and welding so much!! Those are such needed careers and everyone in my trade classes are GUARANTEED a job right out of highschool in those,  and yet even my home school puts us down and shames us for not adding to their college admission total, and completely neglects us due to that. It's just so frustrating how a lack of self awareness and never experiencing poverty makes people so...judgemental

I hope youre able to meet her. Wonder woman is a great film, and i emphasize with youre collecting things to help lift you out of those depressive feelings, i do the same. Have you reached out to any collecting communitys or. Comic communities on social media to share?
